changes: Add explicit mode choices classification(default), backlog, core, full. Unknown mode exits2. Preserve existing classification output/exit compatibility; strict modes add separately named backlog/qualification verdicts.

Load actual taskbook once. Validate duplicate IDs/status types and each case/feature backlog_tasks list. A required non-independent case or applicable missing/partial feature requires at least one actual pending/in_progress task; done, unknown, closed-only or absent task references cannot satisfy remaining work. Completed task/evidence references are reported separately.

Validate case IDs/dispositions/profile/denominator types and exact duplicate rows; denominator=false requires not_applicable and a nonempty explicit source applicability scope/reason. Unsupported, blocked, failed, not_run and local_consistency stay required. Reject attempted public whole-key exclusion where only an internal-role reason exists.

Preserve all original case source/peer/disposition/artifact/test fields; add only reviewed backlog/applicability annotations. For historical055/067, narrow the existing reason to the historical/internal role and add separately applicable current055 public and067/073 raw-extension cells. No artifact is reclassified as independent by this plan.

For an independent registry row require nonempty local artifact references that exist and are actual regular files; this checks structural attribution only and cannot replace the original accepted validator/runtime proof. Gap closure through a task becoming done cannot turn a local/failed/unsupported row into an independent result.

Backlog mode succeeds only with no malformed/untracked remaining cases/features AND no schema/runtime drift. Core/full modes additionally require every selected required row to retain an independently accepted exact-source result, with no selected missing/partial runtime/feature/version gaps; qualified implementation names do not imply qualified behavior.

Name core scope explicitly as registered core/transactional/group/admin profiles; full selects all seven registered profiles and all claimed client features. Exclusions apply only to their declared roles; broker production qualification is a separate scope and is not inferred. Both current completeness booleans remain false.

Keep verified current93 inventory comparison intact. Reject unknown extra classification types and keep a classified synthetic key/version unable to establish authoritative current completeness; default classification may still report a deliberately classified synthetic gap without calling it production proof.

Report source-corpus limitations explicitly. Known inventory567 source files/2477 method or entry names has no parameter expansion and omits other Java producer/consumer/security/unit source families. Existing root source-applicability proposals remain unassigned; mode success for registered backlog does not close exhaustive KL01-14.

A present feature row is implementation provenance, not an independent verdict. Core/full require explicitly reviewed conformance_case_ids (or equivalent exact evidence-scope bindings) to independently accepted required cases for every selected applicable feature. Unmapped present-feature qualification remains open under KL01-14; do not infer it from a matching API name, Rust test path, done implementation card or profile-wide smoke.

Protect denominators against empty/truncated registries as well as false flags: strict modes report the authoritative registered source/case set and fail completeness when required applicability or parameter coverage is unresolved. Registered-backlog mode may report that all enumerated gaps have open tasks, while exhaustive_upstream_applicability_complete stays false. Never promote classified API drift into a full qualification verdict.
